name: Spin And Spell
review:
Spin And Spell is a 20-line Halloween slot from 2019 with castle scatters, free spins that can be retriggered, and an expanding wild. A separate bonus round adds a mini-game to the trick-or-treat theme.

BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 3,049x maximum and a 95.9% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 102 spins on average. A gamble round is also available after wins. It's a fun seasonal classic, though newer BGaming games offer better RTP.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 102 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
